name: Raven
source: Raven is Edgar's personal servant. He possesses mysterious green eyes and exceptional fighting skills. It is revealed that Raven was born with a sprite residing within him. Edgar has mastery over the sprite, and hence Raven. According to Raven, Edgar would never take advantage of this power. And because Edgar accepts him despite his obscurities, Raven is pleased to serve him.
